premise: The sun comes back while it still drizzles and a rainbow appears; Rabbit races to find where it touches the ground, Deer and Butterfly follow, and it is always one meadow further, so they sit down and look.
inspiration: The pot of gold at the rainbow's end (folk), turned: the treasure is looking at it together.
lesson: Some things are for looking at, not catching.
learning: A rainbow appears when the sun shines while it is still raining.

en-US.title: The Rainbow Hunt
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} {canvas:rain 0.4 12s} {sfx:drizzle} It had been raining all morning. Then the sun peeked out from behind the cloud — and it was STILL raining. Sun and rain at the same time. [gasps] And there, across the sky, {canvas:rainbow 0.9 30s} stretched a rainbow. Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple. Rabbit {rabbit:hop x3} was off. [rushed] It touches the ground over there! Deer {deer:pulse} followed with long careful steps. Butterfly {butterfly:hop} fluttered after. Over the meadow. The rainbow's end was… one meadow further. Over that one. {rabbit:hop x2} Still further. Past the flower, {flower:pulse} with a raindrop on every petal. [curious] Rabbit stopped, puffing. Deer looked up. Maybe it is not for catching, he said. Maybe it is for looking at. [softly] So they sat down in the wet grass, and looked. Sun on their faces. Rain on their noses. {deer:glow} {rabbit:glow} {butterfly:glow} [happily] And when the rain stopped, the rainbow faded. They had seen the whole thing.

es-ES.title: A la caza del arcoíris
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.4} {canvas:rain 0.4 12s} {sfx:drizzle} Había estado lloviendo toda la mañana. Entonces el sol asomó detrás de la nube… y seguía lloviendo. Sol y lluvia a la vez. [gasps] Y allí, cruzando el cielo, {canvas:rainbow 0.9 30s} apareció un arcoíris. Rojo, naranja, amarillo, verde, azul, morado. Conejo {rabbit:hop x3} salió disparado. [rushed] ¡Toca el suelo allí! Ciervo {deer:pulse} lo siguió con pasos largos. Mariposa {butterfly:hop} fue detrás. Cruzaron el prado. El final del arcoíris estaba… un prado más allá. Cruzaron ese también. {rabbit:hop x2} Todavía más allá. Pasaron junto a la flor, {flower:pulse} con una gota de lluvia en cada pétalo. [curious] Conejo se paró, resoplando. Ciervo miró hacia arriba. A lo mejor no es para cogerlo, dijo. A lo mejor es para mirarlo. [softly] Y se sentaron en la hierba mojada, y miraron. El sol en la cara. La lluvia en la nariz. {deer:glow} {rabbit:glow} {butterfly:glow} [happily] Y cuando paró de llover, el arcoíris se apagó. Lo habían visto entero.

drizzle.prompt: a light sunny drizzle on meadow grass, soft and sparse, birds nearby
